sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('2100ec49-57b2-4330-ab5f-057ce9b7e4d0', '35e613e3-7aae-4152-b827-99d1ee7841be') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment
